title: Quotient compatibility of the normalized total tensor comparison
statement: Let R be the completed coefficient sheaf on X_proet and S_n its recorded finite quotients. Suppose b_n is a natural S_n-linear isomorphism from reduction of a total tensor to the total tensor of the two reductions, carrying 1 tensor (x tensor y) in each (p,q)-summand to (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y). Then after scalar restriction, b_n commutes with the consecutive quotient transitions: T(r_n) followed by b_n equals b_(n+1) followed by the tensor transition. This is an equality of natural chain maps on all pairs of complexes, with no K-flatness hypothesis. All reduction, tensor, and transition maps are those recorded in def-weil-integral-reduction-tower, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model and lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined.

source.place: Section tensor products (section-tensor-product), scalar-extension identity immediately following the sectionwise tensor construction; sheafification compatibility in lemma-sheafification-tensor. Combined with total complexes, Stacks 06YM and 07A4; Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.4.10.

proof.text: Extension and scalar restriction preserve the coproduct defining each total degree. Precompose the two proposed maps with its extended summand injections. A locally surjective sheafification unit and separatedness of the target reduce equality to s tensor (x tensor y); tensor additivity gives equality on the presheaf generators.

The isomorphism b_n is S_n-linear. Extend its normalization at scalar 1 to scalar s, moving s into the first tensor factor. The two routes on s tensor (x tensor y) are both (rho(s) tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y), by the scalar and tensor transition generator formulas. The coproduct injections and degreewise equality give the required natural-transformation equation.

proof_origin.note: Extract the strict finite-level comparison and the separate quotient-compatibility argument from the completed tensor calculation; no derived descent is included in these lemmas.

theorem integralTensorTransitionCompatibility
    (b : ∀ n : ℕ, coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t}

      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) ⋙

    (hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ)
      (p q : ℤ) (V : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj V) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj V),
      (((b n).hom.app (P, Q)).f (p + q)).val.app V

          (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t + 1, t}
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P Q p q (p + q) rfl V x y)) =
        integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E X n P Q p q V
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E X n _ V 1 x)
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E X n _ V 1 y)) (n : ℕ) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t}
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
      (unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E X n) ≫
        (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (b n) (integralOperationsRestrict l E X n)).hom =
    (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (b (n + 1)) (integralOperationsRestrict l E X (n + 1))).hom ≫
      integralOperationsTensorTransition l E X n
